camera_source_note: Zorvane can boot the NEXT pitch headless (`TERRA_HEADLESS=1`) and can grab a windowed viewport under Xvfb (`scripts/capture-docs-frames.sh` in the Zorvane repo). These camera images are labelled schematics, not Zorvane renders.
